What we do

Programs that
empower and uplift.

SJCDC delivers education, health, community-support, and youth programs designed with — and for — the residents of Anacostia.

Education

Education, Literacy & Computer Skills

Learning is at the core of empowerment. SJCDC provides tutoring for children and adults, literacy and reading support, and hands-on computer-skills training — helping residents build the foundation they need to succeed in school and the workplace.

Tutoring for children and adults

Literacy and reading programs

Summer reading program and math help

Computer skills training

Career-outlook opportunities

Health

Health & Wellness

Good health is the ground everything else is built on. In collaboration with partners like Unity Health Care, SJCDC brings health education and screenings directly to the community — addressing the issues that matter most to Ward 8 families.

Diet, nutrition, and exercise guidance

Diabetes and heart-disease workshops

Mental-health awareness

Community health screenings and HIV testing

Saturday women's group (train the trainer)

Community

Community Support

When neighbors need help, SJCDC shows up. We host community meals, distribute food in partnership with the Capital Area Food Bank and Horton's Kids, and provide direct assistance to families — especially around the holidays.

Community Meals
Free meals served with dignity and joy
Food Distribution
Pantry partnerships across Ward 8
Gift-Card Giveaways
Support for families at community events
Holiday Assistance
Direct help for families in need
Youth

Youth Development

The next generation is our greatest investment. SJCDC connects young people to mentorship, hands-on learning, and enrichment — from garden projects to summer programs — that build confidence and open doors.

Mentorship
Caring adults invested in youth
Garden & Nature
Hands-on learning outdoors
Summer Programs
Reading, math, and enrichment
Service & Leadership
Youth volunteering in the community
